scopeLimits: The WUP point is a population-weighted settlement locator, not a municipal boundary. A point hit does not establish citywide coverage. No personal owner, address, tax, account or applicant data was requested or retained; no authentication or account credential was used.
name: Eskisehir
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: Eskişehir’s cadastral and title registry offices are confirmed by official TKGM sources. The shared public parcel service is documented, but today’s exact city point response was rate-limited before returning a feature.
technicalBlocker: The TKGM endpoint returned HTTP 403 with an explicit daily query limit exceeded message at both the exact WUP point and a non-property control point. No parcel geometry or locality metadata was returned, so this is a temporary rate-limit blocker, not evidence of absent city coverage.
remainingUncertainty: Whether the exact WUP point intersects an indexed parcel and what administrative/locality labels the service returns; no exact absence response or full polygon could be confirmed.
nextStep: Retry after the service quota window resets, then inspect only a valid, full, closed polygon response and safe locality/parcel-key fields. Do not interpret a fresh throttle response as no coverage.

executedQueries.query: Eskişehir resmi tapu kadastro müdürlüğü parsel sorgu Eskişehir Kadastro Müdürlüğü
executedQueries.scope: Verify city-specific cadastre and test the official anonymous parcel point endpoint at the WUP point.
executedQueries.result: TKGM’s official Eskişehir Regional Directorate list identifies Eskişehir Kadastro Müdürlüğü and central Odunpazarı and Tepebaşı title offices. The official TKGM parcel page documents the public free viewer, polygon-oriented parcel lookup/download options and prohibits owner-name/T.C. identity searches. A direct request to the shared public point API at the exact WUP coordinate returned HTTP 403 with “Günlük sorgu limitini aştınız” (daily query limit exceeded); a bounded control request at (0,0) got the same response. No Eskişehir polygon or city-specific API locality response could be verified during this request window.
